verified.kill_fact: Resideo's 7/1/26 PR confirms Board set record date 7/20/26, distribution date 8/3/26, tax-free 1-for-2 ratio (one ADI per two REZI), ADIG on NYSE 8/4/26; ADI priced $400M 7.125% 2034 notes + syndicated $600M term B (+$500M revolver) to fund a ~$900M cash dividend to Resideo. Forward and unfired as of 7/2/26.
verified.analysis: Resideo's Board set the record date (7/20/26) and distribution date (8/3/26) for the tax-free 1-for-2 spin of ADI Global Distribution (ADIG on NYSE 8/4/26), confirmed in the 7/1/26 PR and the ADI Form 10-12B/A information statement. ADI is committing ~$1.0B of new debt ($600M term B + $400M 7.125% 2034 notes + revolver) to fund a ~$900M one-time cash dividend to RemainCo Resideo — a concrete, dated, forward capital-structure event, not yet fired and not a macro bet. Edge is medium since the dated timeline is now public and partially priced, but the RemainCo deleveraging/re-rate and ADIG when-issued dynamics still offer a clean stub-vs-parent setup into 7/20 record.
